subject: prd/init-hardening
statement: Where GitHub mode is resolved and an origin remote exists, the system shall derive the coordinate from it; where none exists interactively, the system shall elicit a shape-validated `owner/name` and configure origin itself.
rationale: the coordinate died six stages in (`#D-8`, `#F-3`)
fit_criterion: origin-present runs ask nothing; origin-absent interactive runs elicit, validate the shape (re-ask on failure), and leave origin configured
